<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><b>Introductory Note</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">On July 1, 2026 (the &#8220;Distribution Date&#8221;),
at 12:01 a.m. New York City time, the previously-announced separation (the &#8220;Separation&#8221;) of Mobility Global Inc. (&#8220;Mobility
Global&#8221;) from S&amp;P Global Inc. (&#8220;S&amp;P Global&#8221;) became effective. The separation of Mobility Global, which comprises
the business of S&amp;P Global and its subsidiaries with respect to providing analytics, marketing, planning solutions, reports, forecasts
and vehicle history data for the automotive sector, which operated under the S&amp;P Global Mobility division, was achieved through S&amp;P
Global&#8217;s distribution (the &#8220;Distribution&#8221;) of 100% of the shares of Mobility Global common stock to holders of S&amp;P
Global common stock as of the close of business on June 15, 2026 (the &#8220;Record Date&#8221;) after certain restructuring transactions
were completed. S&amp;P Global stockholders of record received one share of Mobility Global common stock for every share of S&amp;P Global
common stock held as of the Record Date. Following the Distribution, Mobility Global became an independent, public company with its common
stock listed under the symbol &#8220;MBGL&#8221; on the New York Stock Exchange.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">In this amendment (the &#8220;Amendment No. 1&#8221;),
S&amp;P Global amends its Current Report on Form 8-K filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission on July 1, 2026 (the &#8220;Original
Form 8-K&#8221;) that reported the completion of the Separation. The Original Form 8-K did not include the unaudited pro forma financial
information of S&amp;P Global reflecting the performance of S&amp;P Global&#8217;s business after giving effect to the Separation. This
Amendment No. 1 is being filed to include such pro forma financial information attached as Exhibit 99.2 under Item 9.01(b) of this Amendment
No. 1.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">Unaudited pro forma financial information included
in this Amendment No. 1 has been presented to illustrate the estimated effects of the Separation and is not necessarily indicative of
the results of operations that S&amp;P Global would have achieved had the Separation been completed as of the dates indicated or of the
results that may be obtained in the future.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><b>Item 7.01 Regulation FD Disclosure</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">On July 6, 2026, S&amp;P Global issued a press
release, furnished as Exhibit 99.1 and incorporated herein by reference, providing financial information for full year 2025, the four
quarters of 2025 and the first quarter of 2026, reflecting the completion of the spin-off of Mobility Global and segment recast updates.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in">The information contained in this Item 7.01, including
Exhibit 99.1 attached hereto, is being furnished and shall not be deemed filed for purposes of Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act
of 1934, as amended, or otherwise subject to the liabilities of Section 18. Furthermore, the information contained in this report shall
not be deemed to be incorporated by reference into any registration statement or other document filed pursuant to the Securities Act of
1933, as amended.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><b>Item 9.01 Financial Statements and Exhibits.</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">(b) The unaudited pro forma condensed consolidated statements of income
of S&amp;P Global for the three months ended March 31, 2026 and for the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024 and 2023 and the unaudited
pro forma condensed consolidated balance sheet of S&amp;P Global as of March 31, 2026 are included as Exhibit 99.2 to this Amendment
No. 1, which is incorporated by reference in this Item 9.01.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">(d) Exhibits.</p>
